name: e5
description: E5 platform and runtime comparison: E1's cells (every operation of all 30 algorithms, the library's reuse arm, one process per operation, first call cold) run natively on the host, outside the container (on the Mac: macOS, liboqs 0.16.0 with the production-like build flags and OpenSSL 3.0.22, both compiled by Apple clang; started with scripts/native-mac.sh). No CPU pinning is possible on macOS: the measuring thread asks for user-interactive QoS and the core type is checked with the canary. Compared with E1 in the container on the same machine. E1's fast/slow classification; 5 repetitions.
